finalText:
**Build passes now, 0 errors.**

Two real bugs from the bump, both fixed:

1. [options.js:7](src/core/options.js:7) read `options.retries`, but the bumped bundler now sends `retryCount`. Was throwing on `undefined.toFixed`.
2. [retryPolicy.js:8](src/net/retryPolicy.js:8) treated unset `backoffEnabled` as invalid. New config loader leaves it `undefined` instead of `false`. Now `undefined` means disabled.

The rest was just deprecation noise from the bump, harmless. Build finishes with 8 warnings, 0 errors, exit code 0.
